transcript.content: My HP printer stopped printing. Patients are waiting.
Let me help. What's your name?
Is it just this printer or others too?
This is the only printer having issues.
Any recent changes to the network?
The network switch was rebooted last night.
That could be the cause. Let me check the printer connection.

ticket.summary: HP Printer offline after network maintenance
ticket.description: Dr. Emily Chen at Westside Medical Centre. HP LaserJet Pro M404dn showing offline. Network switch rebooted last night.

expected.notes: This is a printer scenario but filed under outlook scenario_id. The engine uses the scenario_id from the assessment. If scenario_id doesn't match the actual call content, the extraction prompt may reference wrong context. This tests whether the engine catches the mismatch.
